events.description: Grid of 20x12 squares is created and filled with sequential integer labels from 1 to 240.
events.clip_query: A grid of numbered squares from 1 to 240 appears on screen.

events.description: Non-prime numbers fade to low opacity, and prime numbers are copied to a list at the top next to 'Primes:'.
events.clip_query: Non-prime numbers fade out while prime numbers are highlighted and collected at the top.

events.description: The grid is restored to full opacity, and the text 'Reduce all mod' is introduced.

events.description: The grid rows are animated to separate vertically, aligning into columns to visualize modular reduction for a selected prime.
